description:
Full text of a decision, by `id` or by `numero` (+ `court`).
Several decisions with that number: list `decisions` (ECHR/CJEU: the one
judgment is served, the rest in `autres_documents`).
An administrative number alone ("2200433") is refused; CE: see `homonymes`.
Also reads doctrine (cada:…, ddd:…), JORFTEXT and KALIARTI ids.

Examples:
  get_decision(id="CETATEXT000007641393")
  get_decision(numero="497566", court="CE")
  get_decision(numero="23/05688", court_name="CA Douai")   # RG
  get_decision(numero="24-14.641")  # Cour de cassation appeal; likewise
    2024L02643 (commercial court), 6538/74 (ECHR), C-72/24 (CJEU)

Args:
    id: id from a search (JURITEXT, CETATEXT, 001-…, CELEX, JORFTEXT…)
        or a judicial/European case number
    numero: case, appeal (pourvoi), RG, commercial court, ECHR or CJEU number
    court: CE | CAA | TA | CONSTIT | CASS | CA | TJ | TCOM | CPH | CEDH | CJUE
    court_name: "TA Lyon", "CA Douai"
    nature: DC, QPC… (CONSTIT, shared number)
